title: Verb to be: am / is / are
summary: Use am, is and are to talk about identity, age, descriptions, location and states in the present.

explanation.en: We use am, is and are to say who or what someone is, describe people and things, talk about age, feelings and location in the present.
explanation.ru: Am, is и are нужны, чтобы говорить о том, кто или что это, описывать людей и предметы, говорить о возрасте, состоянии и местонахождении в настоящем.

forms.label: Present
forms.pattern: I am · he/she/it is · you/we/they are

forms.label: Negative
forms.pattern: I am not · he/she/it isn't · you/we/they aren't

forms.label: Questions
forms.pattern: Am I ...? · Is he/she/it ...? · Are you/we/they ...?

commonMistakes.note: With be, do not use do/does for negatives.
With be, form the question by moving am/is/are before the subject.
